title: criterion-1.5x gate needs JIT-context wrapper for per-issue kernel-id resolution
description:
The `criterion-1.5x` JIT gate (registered in 4f845881 via `jit gate define`) currently has `--checker-command "./dev/benchmarks/ppc-compare.sh"` with no `--pass-context` and no kernel-id parameterisation. When invoked on any Tier A–D issue, it'll fail with the usage text + exit 2 because no positional kernel-id is provided. The gate definition is correct but **non-invokable** in its current form.

## What's missing

A small wrapper that extracts the issue's kernel-id from the JIT context (issue labels or context.kernel-id) and forwards to `dev/benchmarks/ppc-compare.sh <kernel-id>`. Pattern mirrors `scripts/asm-artefact-present.sh` (registered for `asm-artefact-present` gate in c3a9a4cb).

## Proposed design

1. **Label convention.** Add a label namespace `ppc-kernel:<id>` on every Tier A–D issue (A1 through D2 — 13 kernels). E.g., `cad241e6` carries `ppc-kernel:A3` (Solinas), `1c1c4242` carries `ppc-kernel:B1`, etc.

2. **Wrapper script.** Add `scripts/criterion-1.5x.sh`:
   - Read `JIT_CONTEXT_FILE` (set by JIT when `--pass-context` is set on the gate).
   - Extract `ppc-kernel:<id>` from issue labels via `jq`.
   - Forward to `./dev/benchmarks/ppc-compare.sh <id>`.
   - Pass through exit code (0 PASS / 1 FAIL / 2 infra / 3 TBD).

3. **Re-define gate.** Drop the existing definition and recreate with `--pass-context --checker-command "./scripts/criterion-1.5x.sh"`.

4. **Wire labels.** For each Tier A–D task issue, run `jit issue update <id> --label ppc-kernel:<X>`.

## Scope/non-goals

- Don't add the gate to each Tier issue yet — that happens at Wave 3+ planning when the gate is functional and baselines are pinned (b2ecd2ff).
- Don't change ppc-compare.sh — its standalone CLI stays as-is.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `scripts/criterion-1.5x.sh` exists and is executable.
- [hard] Wrapper extracts kernel-id from `ppc-kernel:` label and exits with the same code ppc-compare.sh would.
- [hard] Wrapper has its own unit test (synthetic JIT_CONTEXT_FILE → expected kernel-id forwarded).
- [hard] `criterion-1.5x` gate redefined with `--pass-context --checker-command "./scripts/criterion-1.5x.sh"`.
- [hard] All 13 Tier A–D task issues carry a `ppc-kernel:<id>` label.

## Notes

Discovered during 4f845881 close. Wired as dep of 166b2691 (S0 story) so the wrapper lands before any Tier-A worker tries to add the gate to their issue.
